title: [The Bone Crypt] I built a domino-based roguelite deckbuilder using AI for art/music and coded the logic myself. I have 97 keys left for playtesters!
author: t-squaredGaming
selftext:
Hey everyone,
​I’m a solo dev building The Bone Crypt, a roguelite deckbuilder that completely replaces cards with dominoes. You chain pips together to build attacks, trigger status effects, and manage your board layout.


​Because I wanted to focus entirely on building tight mechanics and deep synergies, I used AI tools to generate the art assets, icons, and music. I know a lot of standard gaming subs immediately hate on this, so I wanted to bring it to a community that actually understands the workflow.


​I'm currently looking for players who love strategy games to test the balance and try to completely break the logic I've built. I need help with bug hunting, mechanic suggestions, and brutal, honest feedback.


​What's in this build:
​Classes & Relics: Different starting loadouts (like the Rogue's Loaded Dice) and run-altering items.


​Solo & PvP: A full solo campaign, plus a 1v1 online PvP mode.


​I’m using FirstLook to distribute the Steam keys, and I have 97 spots left. You just need to link a Steam account to claim one instantly.


​👉 [the-bone-crypt.firstlook.gg](http://the-bone-crypt.firstlook.gg)


​Would love to hear your thoughts on the gameplay loop!
